description: This source file implements event handling and management for a CWMP daemon, including creation, starting, stopping, and cleanup of event loops and associated signals and bus events.

methods.name: cwmp_evlp_get
methods.description: Returns the main event loop; logs error if not initialized.

methods.name: cwmp_evlp_create
methods.description: Initializes the event loop, signals, and bus events with provided bus contexts.

methods.name: cwmp_evlp_start
methods.description: Starts dispatching events in the main loop.

methods.name: cwmp_evlp_clean
methods.description: Cleans up and frees all allocated event resources and the event loop.
